 Follow Mamdani hobbles on crutches to City Hall after suffering Archilles’ heel injury during soccer match
 Craig McCarthy Updated Fri, November 20, 2026 at 2:20 PM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Mamdani's Achilles' heel.
 The Big Apple's young mayor hobbled into a City Hall event on crutches Friday morning after going down during an indoor soccer match with the city's press corps.
 Mayor Zohran Mamdani, who had to be rolled in a wheelchair prior to the press conference on the closure of Rikers Island , will be on the shelf for at least eight months due to an Achilles' heel injury.
 Mayor Zohran Mamdani uses crutches at City Hall on Nov. 20 after injuring his Achilles tendon during a soccer game. William Farrington
 Mamdani faces an estimated eight-month recovery following his non-contact soccer injury. nyc.gov
 He sat on a stool during the event, with a boot on his right foot.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The mayor, who just recently turned 35, suffered a non-contact injury while running for a ball on the indoor turf.
 Mamdani sits on a stool during a Nov. 20 news conference to address the scheduled closure of Rikers Island. William Farrington
 His detail was overheard asking at the event where the closest hospital was, and staffers helped him out of the facility late in the second half.
 Despite the injury, City Hall beat the press corps 8-4.
